# Purpose

This document evaluates the repeated-sampling performance of the stratified design used in Sections C and D and compares it with an equal-sized SRSWOR benchmark.

A total of 1,000 Monte Carlo repetitions are used. In each repetition, a stratified sample of 414 students and an SRSWOR sample of 414 students are independently selected from the fixed finite population. For each design, the estimated mean, estimated standard error and 95% confidence interval are recorded.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE)
```

# 1. Load and verify the finite population

Place `wits_printing_population_with_auxiliary.csv` in the same RCloud working directory as this RMD.

```{r load}
population <- read.csv(
  "wits_printing_population_with_auxiliary.csv",
  stringsAsFactors=FALSE
)

stopifnot(nrow(population) == 10000)

required <- c("student_id","faculty","pages_month")
if (!all(required %in% names(population))) {
  stop("Required population variables are missing.")
}

N <- nrow(population)
true_mean <- mean(population$pages_month)
true_variance <- var(population$pages_month)

cat("Population size:", N, "\n")
cat("True population mean:", round(true_mean,4), "\n")
cat("True population variance:", round(true_variance,4), "\n")
```

# 2. Define the sampling designs

The stratified design uses the same Neyman allocation as Sections C and D.

```{r design}
allocation <- data.frame(
  faculty=c(
    "Commerce, Law and Management",
    "Engineering and the Built Environment",
    "Health Sciences",
    "Humanities",
    "Science"
  ),
  N_h=c(2500,2000,1700,2300,1500),
  n_h=c(97,55,77,138,47),
  stringsAsFactors=FALSE
)

allocation$W_h <- allocation$N_h/N
allocation$f_h <- allocation$n_h/allocation$N_h

n_total <- sum(allocation$n_h)
z <- qnorm(0.975)

allocation
cat("Total sample size per repetition:", n_total, "\n")
```

# 3. Simulation settings

The assignment requires at least 500 repetitions; 1,000 repetitions are used here.

```{r settings}
B <- 1000
simulation_seed <- 4106
set.seed(simulation_seed)

cat("Monte Carlo repetitions:", B, "\n")
cat("Simulation seed:", simulation_seed, "\n")
```

# 4. Storage objects

```{r storage}
strat_est <- numeric(B)
strat_se <- numeric(B)
strat_lower <- numeric(B)
strat_upper <- numeric(B)

srs_est <- numeric(B)
srs_se <- numeric(B)
srs_lower <- numeric(B)
srs_upper <- numeric(B)
```

# 5. Repeated sampling simulation

```{r simulation}
for (b in seq_len(B)) {

  # -----------------------------
  # Stratified random sample
  # -----------------------------
  stratum_samples <- vector("list", nrow(allocation))

  for (h in seq_len(nrow(allocation))) {

    f <- allocation$faculty[h]

    d_h <- population[
      population$faculty == f,
    ]

    idx_h <- sample(
      seq_len(nrow(d_h)),
      size=allocation$n_h[h],
      replace=FALSE
    )

    stratum_samples[[h]] <- d_h[idx_h, ]
  }

  # Stratum sample means and variances
  ybar_h <- numeric(nrow(allocation))
  s2_h <- numeric(nrow(allocation))

  for (h in seq_len(nrow(allocation))) {
    y_h <- stratum_samples[[h]]$pages_month
    ybar_h[h] <- mean(y_h)
    s2_h[h] <- var(y_h)
  }

  strat_est[b] <- sum(allocation$W_h * ybar_h)

  strat_var_b <- sum(
    allocation$W_h^2 *
      (1-allocation$f_h) *
      s2_h/allocation$n_h
  )

  strat_se[b] <- sqrt(strat_var_b)
  strat_lower[b] <- strat_est[b] - z*strat_se[b]
  strat_upper[b] <- strat_est[b] + z*strat_se[b]

  # -----------------------------
  # Equal-sized SRSWOR
  # -----------------------------
  idx_srs <- sample(
    seq_len(N),
    size=n_total,
    replace=FALSE
  )

  srs_y <- population$pages_month[idx_srs]

  srs_est[b] <- mean(srs_y)

  srs_var_b <- (1-n_total/N) *
    var(srs_y)/n_total

  srs_se[b] <- sqrt(srs_var_b)
  srs_lower[b] <- srs_est[b] - z*srs_se[b]
  srs_upper[b] <- srs_est[b] + z*srs_se[b]
}

cat("Simulation completed successfully.\n")
```

# 6. Performance-measure function

```{r performance-function}
performance <- function(est, se, lower, upper, truth) {

  bias <- mean(est) - truth
  relative_bias <- 100*bias/truth
  empirical_se <- sd(est)
  average_estimated_se <- mean(se)
  mse <- mean((est-truth)^2)
  rmse <- sqrt(mse)
  coverage <- mean(lower <= truth & upper >= truth)
  average_ci_width <- mean(upper-lower)
  mcse_coverage <- sqrt(coverage*(1-coverage)/length(est))

  data.frame(
    Mean_Estimate=mean(est),
    Bias=bias,
    Relative_Bias_Percent=relative_bias,
    Empirical_SE=empirical_se,
    Average_Estimated_SE=average_estimated_se,
    MSE=mse,
    RMSE=rmse,
    Coverage=coverage,
    Coverage_Percent=100*coverage,
    Average_CI_Width=average_ci_width,
    MCSE_Coverage=mcse_coverage
  )
}
```

# 7. Calculate simulation performance

```{r performance-results}
strat_perf <- performance(
  strat_est, strat_se,
  strat_lower, strat_upper,
  true_mean
)

srs_perf <- performance(
  srs_est, srs_se,
  srs_lower, srs_upper,
  true_mean
)

strat_perf$Design <- "Stratified Neyman"
srs_perf$Design <- "SRSWOR"

performance_table <- rbind(
  strat_perf,
  srs_perf
)

performance_table <- performance_table[
  ,
  c(
    "Design",
    "Mean_Estimate",
    "Bias",
    "Relative_Bias_Percent",
    "Empirical_SE",
    "Average_Estimated_SE",
    "MSE",
    "RMSE",
    "Coverage",
    "Coverage_Percent",
    "Average_CI_Width",
    "MCSE_Coverage"
  )
]

performance_table
```

# 8. Rounded report table

```{r rounded-table}
report_table <- performance_table

numeric_cols <- sapply(report_table, is.numeric)
report_table[numeric_cols] <- lapply(
  report_table[numeric_cols],
  function(x) round(x,4)
)

report_table
```

# 9. Empirical SE versus average estimated SE

This comparison assesses whether the design-based variance estimators correctly reflect the actual repeated-sampling variability.

```{r se-comparison}
se_comparison <- data.frame(
  Design=c("Stratified Neyman","SRSWOR"),
  Empirical_SE=c(
    sd(strat_est),
    sd(srs_est)
  ),
  Average_Estimated_SE=c(
    mean(strat_se),
    mean(srs_se)
  )
)

se_comparison$Difference <- 
  se_comparison$Average_Estimated_SE -
  se_comparison$Empirical_SE

se_comparison
```

# 10. Relative empirical efficiency

The ratio of empirical variances provides a repeated-sampling comparison of precision.

```{r efficiency}
empirical_var_strat <- var(strat_est)
empirical_var_srs <- var(srs_est)

empirical_deff <- empirical_var_strat /
  empirical_var_srs

empirical_relative_efficiency <-
  empirical_var_srs /
  empirical_var_strat

cat("Empirical stratified variance:",
    round(empirical_var_strat,6), "\n")

cat("Empirical SRSWOR variance:",
    round(empirical_var_srs,6), "\n")

cat("Empirical variance ratio (Stratified/SRS):",
    round(empirical_deff,4), "\n")

cat("Empirical relative efficiency (SRS/Stratified):",
    round(empirical_relative_efficiency,4), "\n")
```

# 11. Distribution of estimates

```{r estimate-hist-strat, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
hist(
  strat_est,
  breaks=30,
  main="Distribution of Stratified Mean Estimates Across 1,000 Repetitions",
  xlab="Estimated mean pages per month"
)

abline(v=true_mean, lty=2, lwd=2)
```

```{r estimate-hist-srs, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
hist(
  srs_est,
  breaks=30,
  main="Distribution of SRSWOR Mean Estimates Across 1,000 Repetitions",
  xlab="Estimated mean pages per month"
)

abline(v=true_mean, lty=2, lwd=2)
```

# 12. Direct comparison of estimates

```{r boxplot-estimates, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
boxplot(
  strat_est,
  srs_est,
  names=c("Stratified","SRSWOR"),
  ylab="Estimated mean pages per month",
  main="Repeated-Sampling Distribution of the Mean Estimator"
)

abline(h=true_mean, lty=2, lwd=2)
```

# 13. Empirical SE and average estimated SE plot

```{r se-plot, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
se_matrix <- rbind(
  c(sd(strat_est), sd(srs_est)),
  c(mean(strat_se), mean(srs_se))
)

barplot(
  se_matrix,
  beside=TRUE,
  names.arg=c("Stratified","SRSWOR"),
  ylab="Standard error",
  main="Empirical SE versus Average Estimated SE",
  legend.text=c("Empirical SE","Average estimated SE")
)
```

# 14. Coverage comparison

```{r coverage-plot, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
coverage_values <- 100*c(
  mean(strat_lower <= true_mean &
       strat_upper >= true_mean),
  mean(srs_lower <= true_mean &
       srs_upper >= true_mean)
)

barplot(
  coverage_values,
  names.arg=c("Stratified","SRSWOR"),
  ylim=c(0,100),
  ylab="95% CI coverage (%)",
  main="Empirical 95% Confidence-Interval Coverage"
)

abline(h=95, lty=2, lwd=2)
```

# 15. RMSE comparison

```{r rmse-plot, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
rmse_values <- c(
  sqrt(mean((strat_est-true_mean)^2)),
  sqrt(mean((srs_est-true_mean)^2))
)

barplot(
  rmse_values,
  names.arg=c("Stratified","SRSWOR"),
  ylab="RMSE",
  main="RMSE Comparison Across 1,000 Repetitions"
)
```

# 16. Save simulation-level results

```{r simulation-data}
simulation_results <- data.frame(
  repetition=seq_len(B),
  strat_estimate=strat_est,
  strat_se=strat_se,
  strat_ci_lower=strat_lower,
  strat_ci_upper=strat_upper,
  strat_covers=(
    strat_lower <= true_mean &
    strat_upper >= true_mean
  ),
  srs_estimate=srs_est,
  srs_se=srs_se,
  srs_ci_lower=srs_lower,
  srs_ci_upper=srs_upper,
  srs_covers=(
    srs_lower <= true_mean &
    srs_upper >= true_mean
  )
)

head(simulation_results)
```

```{r save}
write.csv(
  simulation_results,
  "section_E_simulation_results_1000.csv",
  row.names=FALSE
)

write.csv(
  performance_table,
  "section_E_performance_summary.csv",
  row.names=FALSE
)

write.csv(
  se_comparison,
  "section_E_empirical_vs_estimated_SE.csv",
  row.names=FALSE
)
```
